meta_description: Elite Decorators Manchester. Professional interior and exterior painting, decorating and wallpapering across Greater Manchester. Free quotes.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting. From feature walls to full room makeovers, we deliver flawless finishes on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: We handle everything from interior refreshes and feature walls to exterior rendering and commercial repaints — all finished to exacting standards.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and bathrooms with expert preparation, premium finishes and zero mess. We protect your furniture and clean up fully.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paint, rendering and masonry work that protects your home and boosts curb appeal. Fully scaffolded for safety.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging, paste application and pattern matching. From contemporary geometric designs to classic patterns, we get the finish flawless.

services.title: Textured Finishes & Ceilings
services.desc: Artex removal, popcorn ceiling work, and decorative finishes. We handle tricky ceiling heights and complex ceiling repairs.

services.title: Wood & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Expert sanding, priming and multi-coat finishes on doors, frames, skirting boards and fitted furniture. Durable results that last.

services.title: Commercial & Contract Work
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, rental properties and multi-site contracts. We work around your business hours with minimal disruption.

about_pullquote: We turn up on time, do the job right, and leave your home spotless.
about_para_1: Elite Decorators was founded in 2007 by Paul Mitchell, a painter frustrated with cowboys cutting corners in Manchester. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation for honest pricing, meticulous preparation and finishes that last. Our team of five trained decorators now completes over 130 jobs a year across Denton, Stockport, Tameside and central Manchester.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, we prep properly (the difference between a job that lasts five years and one that peels in two), and we respect your home. We're fully insured, hold public liability cover, and we're proud members of the Painters' Guild. Nearly 90% of our work comes from repeat customers and personal referrals.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Paul and the lads transformed our sitting room. The prep work was thorough – they covered everything, masked up perfectly – and the finish is absolutely pristine. Three weeks on and it still looks fresh. Would definitely recommend to anyone in Manchester.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had them out to paint our whole kitchen and the hallway. They turned up bang on time, got stuck in, and didn't make a mess like the last lot we used. Fair pricing too. Will be calling them back for the upstairs.
reviews.author: Susan R.

reviews.text: Needed our exterior re-rendered and painted before winter. These guys worked efficiently, managed the scaffolding without fuss, and the result is brilliant. Professional throughout. Highly impressed.
reviews.author: David K.
